def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    from collections import Counter
    c=Counter(x for r in grid for x in r)
    bg=c.most_common(1)[0][0]
    other=[k for k in c if k!=bg]
    oc=other[0] if len(other)==1 else None
    out=[r[:] for r in grid]
    if oc is None: return out
    # find all rectangles of oc with perimeter drawn and interior bg; fill interior
    # enumerate all (r1,c1,r2,c2) with r2>r1+1, c2>c1+1, border all oc
    filled=set()
    for r1 in range(h):
        for c1 in range(w):
            if grid[r1][c1]!=oc: continue
            for r2 in range(r1+2,h):
                if grid[r2][c1]!=oc: continue
                for c2 in range(c1+2,w):
                    if grid[r1][c2]!=oc or grid[r2][c2]!=oc: continue
                    # check full border
                    ok=all(grid[r1][j]==oc and grid[r2][j]==oc for j in range(c1,c2+1)) and \
                       all(grid[i][c1]==oc and grid[i][c2]==oc for i in range(r1,r2+1))
                    if ok:
                        for i in range(r1+1,r2):
                            for j in range(c1+1,c2):
                                if grid[i][j]==bg:
                                    filled.add((i,j))
    for i,j in filled: out[i][j]=4
    return out
